Ground floor furnished house Herceg Novi Suscepan
Ground-floor furnished house Herceg Novi Suscepan. House in excellent condition, fully equipped, 47 m2, consisting of an entrance hall, two bedrooms, a bathroom, a living room with a kitchen, and a courtyard terrace. The area of the yard around the house is 406 m2. Parking provided for two vehicles, cultivated yard. Distance from the sea: 4 km. The house is registered in the real estate cadastre (no permit) in the process of legalization. The price is 215,000 euros.
